title: Sources: Take-Two's Firaxis, which makes the Civilization and XCOM franchises, lays off 33% of its staff, or ~60 jobs; studio head Heather Hazen will also leave (Jason Schreier/Bloomberg)
summary: Jason Schreier / Bloomberg: Sources: Take-Two's Firaxis, which makes the Civilization and XCOM franchises, lays off 33% of its staff, or ~60 jobs; studio head Heather Hazen will also leave — The Maryland-based development studio behind the Civilization and XCOM franchises, laid off around 60 people on Tuesday
